title: Decoupled Transform (Six-Phase)
text: Implement abc and xyz to dqz 1 z 2 o 1 o 2 transform, 3 inputs, 1 output; {Phase-a axis alignment} sets the dqz 1 z 2 o 1 o 2 reference frame alignment. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: abc
ports.summary: a -, b -, and c -phase components vector

ports.name: xyz
ports.summary: x -, y -, and z -phase components vector

ports.name: dqz1z2o1o2
ports.summary: Direct, Quadrature, z 1, z 2, o 1, and o 2 components vector

params.name: Phase-a axis alignment
params.values: dqz 1 z 2 o 1 o 2 reference frame alignment Q-axis (default) | D-axis
